title: SM AC6C
text: 离散时间或连续时间同步电机 AC6C 励磁系统，包括自动电压调节器和励磁机，输入 10 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} 指定初始输出电压、{Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} 指定补偿电阻、{Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} 指定补偿电抗、{Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} 调节器时间常数、{Regulator output gain, K_A (pu)} 调节器增益、{Regulator output time constant, T_A (s)} 调节器时间常数、{Regulator denominator (lag) time constant, T_B (s)} 调节器滞后时间常数、{Regulator numerator (lead) time constant, T_C (s)} 调节器超前时间常数、{Regulator numerator (lead) time constant, T_K (s)} 调节器超前时间常数、{Exciter field current limiter gain, K_H (pu)} 指定励磁机磁场电流限制器增益、{Exciter field current limiter maximum output, V_Hmax (pu)} 指定励磁机磁场电流限制器的最大输出、{Exciter field current limiter reference, V_FELIM (pu)} 指定励磁机磁场电流限制器参考值、{Exciter field current limiter denominator (lag) time constant, T_H (s)} 指定励磁机磁场电流限制器的滞后时间常数、{Exciter field current limiter numerator (lead) time constant, T_J (s)} 指定励磁机磁场电流限制器的超前时间常数、{Maximum regulator output, V_Amax (pu)} 调节器输出上限、{Minimum regulator output, V_Amin (pu)} 调节器输出下限、{Maximum exciter field voltage, E_FEmax (pu)} 指定励磁机电压上限、{Minimum exciter field voltage, E_FEmin (pu)} 指定励磁机电压下限、{Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} 指定 OEL 输入位置、{Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} 指定 UEL 输入位置、{Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} 指定 SCL 输入位置、{Exciter field proportional constant, K_E (pu)} 指定励磁机磁场增益、{Exciter field time constant, T_E (s)} 指定励磁机磁场时间常数、{Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)} 指定整流器负载系数、{Demagnetizing factor, function of exciter alternator reactances, K_D (pu)} 指定去磁系数、{Exciter output voltage for saturation factor S_E(E_1), E_1 (pu)} 指定第一饱和输出电压、{Exciter saturation factor at exciter output voltage E_1, S_E(E_1) (1)} 指定第一饱和查表电压、{Exciter output voltage for saturation factor S_E(E_2), E_2 (pu)} 指定第二饱和输出电压、{Exciter saturation factor at exciter output voltage E_2, S_E(E_2) (1)} 指定第二饱和查表电压、{Maximum exciter field current limit reference, V_FEmax (pu)} 指定励磁机上限、{Minimum exciter voltage output, V_Emin (pu)} 指定励磁机下限，按实例取值。
